rendered: The authors used the FTIR band at 871 cm^−1[1] (the typical PVDF bending band of CH2). Its absence in the reclaimed powder showed that PVDF binder had been removed. That band was absent for the reclaimed cathode powder filtered at high temperature, the hot-filtration condition ([2]100 °C[3]), whereas the room-temperature filtered powder still showed it.[4]
